criteria.name: Timing Adjustable
criteria.remarks: Messages in the corner of the screen close by themselves after 4 seconds, including error messages that show a request id to quote to support, and messages that say how long to wait after too many attempts. Hovering the message or pressing F6 holds it; there is no setting to keep messages longer. Setting up an authenticator app must be finished within 5 minutes; after that the form is replaced by 'Setup session expired' without a warning and you start again. Sign-in links and checks expire after 5 to 15 minutes but can be requested again without losing work; your session lasts a week.

evidence.summary: Toasts: timeout={4000} for every toast (toaster-provider.tsx:9); Base UI pauses the timer on hover, focus and F6 but there is no warning or setting to turn off, adjust or extend. The global error handler puts the request id in the toast description (query/on-error.ts:83-89) and the retry wait of a 429 (on-error.ts:78-82); no other place shows them. Actionable toasts are persistent (reload-prompt.tsx:54, unsaveable-notices.tsx:96). TOTP setup: the form switches to the expired state after 4.5 minutes (totp-setup.tsx:23-27, 83-90) because the backend cookie lives 5 minutes (auth/totps/totps-handlers.ts:29); no warning, no extension. Other limits, restartable without data loss: magic link 15 min, invitation 7 days, oauth-verification 2 h, confirm-mfa 10 min, step-up 10 min (auth/tokens/token-policies.ts:59-92); passkey challenge 5 min; OAuth round trip 5 min; consent 10 min. Sessions last one week (sessions/operations/create-session.ts:88). A lost session redirects to sign-in with a return path and keeps unsynced local work (on-error.ts:92-104). No countdowns or idle timeouts in frontend/src.

Sessions last a week, beyond the 20-hour exception. Sign-in challenges (passkey, email link, step-up) expire after 5 to 10 minutes and can be requested again. Toasts close after 4 seconds; check that none carries information users need to act on.

criteria.name: Pointer Gestures
criteria.remarks: On a phone, pulling the page down refreshes the data; the app has no button for this. In a browser the reload button does the same; in the installed app there is no alternative. Other gestures have a button: zoom in the image viewer has plus and minus buttons, a swiped-away message has a close button, a drawer closes by tapping outside it or pressing Escape, and the attachment carousel has previous and next buttons and the arrow keys.

evidence.summary: Pull to refresh: window touchstart/touchmove/touchend listeners (common/pull-to-refresh.tsx:132-138) trigger handleRefresh (common/app/app-router.tsx:19-26); no in-app refresh button; the PWA runs standalone (vite.config.ts:450-467), so the installed app has no browser reload. Image viewer: wheel and pinch zoom (render/use-pan-zoom.ts:96-108) have zoom in, zoom out and reset buttons (render/image.tsx:46-72). Drawer swipe to dismiss (ui/drawer.tsx:109-118): pointer dismissal and Escape. Toast swipe (ui/toast.tsx:43) has a close button (toast.tsx:61-68). Carousel swipe: previous/next buttons (attachments-carousel.tsx:239-247, ui/carousel.tsx:167-211), dots, and arrow keys (carousel.tsx:95-109); in the dialog the buttons are opacity-0 until hover or focus (attachments-carousel.tsx:241-245), so verify on a touch device that they can be reached. Contact page map (gestureHandling greedy) has zoom buttons; shown only with a googleMapsKey (production).

Gesture handlers in frontend/src/hooks/use-breakpoints.tsx, frontend/src/modules/attachment/render/image-zoom.ts, frontend/src/modules/attachment/render/use-pan-zoom.ts, frontend/src/modules/common/sheeter/drawer.tsx, frontend/src/modules/navigation/floating-nav/button.tsx, frontend/src/modules/ui/toast.tsx; check each has a single-pointer alternative such as a button.

Searched frontend/src for onMouseDown, onPointerDown, onTouchStart and the native listener names (14 hits, none in tests or stories). Down events only start drags, focus or record a position: image pan start (use-pan-zoom.ts:90, 93), column resize start (data-grid/header-cell.tsx:227-242), docs sidebar resize start (docs/docs-layout.tsx:143), pull start (pull-to-refresh.tsx:134), floating nav records the touch point and acts on touchend, aborted when the finger moved more than 12 px (floating-nav/button.tsx:44-53). Grid cells focus on mousedown (data-grid/cell.tsx:82-88); row selection on press needs rowSelectionMode, which no app table sets. An editing cell commits on a mousedown outside it (edit-cell.tsx:72-73), as a blur would. Base UI menus and selects open on mousedown but close again when the pointer is released outside (up reversal). Checkbox and expand toggles act on click. All other actions use onClick.

criteria.name: Label in Name
criteria.remarks: A few buttons have a spoken name that differs from the text on them, so voice control users cannot activate them by saying what they see: the green role button at the top of an organization page (shows 'Admin' or 'Member', is named 'Leave'), the 'Invite' step in the invite dialog title (named 'Go back'), the 'Go to Github' button at the bottom of the About page (named 'Start building'), the 'EN' language button on the authentication error page (named 'Change language'), and 'Read more about Cella' on the About page (named 'Read more'). Workaround: use your voice tool's numbered overlay, or the keyboard.

evidence.summary: facts.labelNotInName of all 26 states plus every button and link in tree.yml whose name differs from its text. Fails (aria-label confirmed in source): org-attachments, org-members, org-settings (and behind invite-dialog, member-sheet): button 'Leave' showing the role (memberships/joined-button.tsx:47); invite-dialog: button 'Go back' showing Invite (user/invite-users.tsx:56); marketing-home: button 'Start building' showing Go to Github (marketing/about/call-to-action.tsx:23) and button 'Read more' showing Read more about Cella (about-page.tsx:83, name is only a prefix); auth-error: button 'Change language' showing EN (me/user-language.tsx:70). Minor, for a person to weigh: org-settings button 'Select language' showing English under the visible label 'Languages'. Not failures: combobox values, the member-sheet sort select showing only an icon, menu-sheet links named after the organization next to an avatar letter and count badge, the logo link 'Go to about page', button 'Open contact form' showing Contact and 'Expand all' showing Expand (name contains the text).

File drop in the uploader has the file picker.

evidence.summary: facts.otherLanguages is empty in all 26 states and facts.lang is en everywhere; all tree.yml text read for non-English passages: names and the fake address are proper names, KvK and bank data are data. One word is Dutch by intent: legal-accessibility list item 'Choose your language: English or Nederlands.' rendered from t('c:nl') with no lang attribute (auth/legal/accessibility-text.tsx:66). The same string fills the language menus (me/user-language.tsx:59, the account Language select, org-settings language selects). WCAG's Understanding marks language names in a language selector with lang (H58) but also says single words count as the surrounding language, so a person may downgrade this to a note.

criteria.name: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data)
criteria.remarks: Deleting an organization, your account, members or attachments and leaving an organization each ask 'Are you sure' first. Revoking an API key in organization settings happens at once with one click and cannot be undone; sessions are also revoked with one click (you can sign in again on that device). Be careful with the Revoke buttons.

evidence.summary: Opened each flow to the confirmation. org-settings 'Delete organization' gives a dialog 'Are you sure you want to delete organization ...?' with Delete and Cancel, Escape closes, no request. account 'Delete account' gives 'Are you sure you want to delete your ... account ...?'. org-members: select a row, 'Remove' gives 'Are you sure you want to delete membership of ... for this organization?'. org page 'Admin' button (aria-label Leave) gives a popconfirm 'Are you sure you want to leave ...?'. org-attachments: select a row, 'Delete' gives 'Are you sure you want to delete 1 attachment?'. account Sessions 'Revoke' on one session sends DELETE /api/me/sessions at once, no dialog (sessions-list.tsx:60). org-settings API keys: created a key and clicked 'Revoke': DELETE .../service-accounts/<id>/keys/<id> sent at once, no dialog, key shown as revoked (service-account-tile.tsx:26-29).

sign-in: typed an address, Continue: the next step shows the email prefilled (disabled field) with 'Sign in with email' and 'Sign in with passkey'; after 'Sign in with email' the page says 'We sent a sign-in link to <address>'. A new address, 'New here? Sign up': the sign-up step shows 'By signing up with <that email>' with the field prefilled. invite-dialog: email entered once as a chip, role chosen, submit sends both; nothing asked twice. Create organization (menu sheet): typing the name fills the handle. /welcome redirects to /home for this admin (has organizations), so onboarding was not exercised; it is not a scope state. The sign-in API refuses Playwright's headless user agent as a bot, so a desktop user agent was set for this check.
